</td><td>

This promise resolves when the task completes or is canceled.

Currently, this promise resolves immediately for most tasks, except [SleeveBladeburnerTask](./bitburner.sleevebladeburnertask.md) and [SleeveInfiltrateTask](./bitburner.sleeveinfiltratetask.md)<!-- -->. Support for other tasks will be added in future versions.

Note that this promise always resolves immediately for tasks that do not track progress (e.g., SleeveClassTask, SleeveCompanyTask, SleeveFactionTask).
